findings: C knyter dessutom takten till något hon inte går i god för: -> Dessutom binder C takten till ensemblen: (q1 rationale, C limb; NEW at fleet-repair-3, which added this sentence to close vote 2's correspondence gap. Two faults in one string. (a) The round avoided the lemma ”lova” in the run-up and kept its sense: ”går i god för” stands 10 tokens before the quotation's own ”kan jag inte lova”, so the reader is told the answer and then given it. Dropping the lexical echo without dropping the semantic one hides the stutter instead of removing it. (b) C is now the only distractor limb in either question with two sentences, and both open on ”C”, so the second reads as a new limb starting. The replacement opens elsewhere and names the ensemble without previewing the quotation's verb.

Symbolen är slingans, inte radens. Det är symbolen som återkommer på uppslagen, medan raden har en enda plats i höstprogrammet. -> Symbolen är slingans, inte radens. Raden själv har en enda plats i höstprogrammet. (q2 rationale, A/B limb; the second sentence is NEW at fleet-repair-3, which replaced an ambiguous ”den” with ”symbolen”. The anaphora repair was right — ”den” did stand immediately after ”radens” — but the round traded it for ”Symbolen”/”symbolen” 7 tokens apart across a sentence boundary, in a sentence whose first half restates the sentence before it. Cutting the restated half removes both the repetition and the redundancy and leaves the contrast the limb exists to draw.

Rätt svar A: skribenten kräver att textningen ska vara regel och inte undantag: ”Från -> Rätt svar A: skribenten kräver att textningen ska vara regel och inte undantag. ”Från (q1 rationale, key limb; NEW at fleet-repair-3, which converted the file's last full-stop-before-a-quotation into a colon so that the unit would carry ”one system rather than two”. The uniformity costs two things. The sentence now carries two colons, which is the fault this gate files in the passage of las-b22-001. And with the change made, all six sentences of the q1 rationale end colon-plus-quotation without exception; read aloud end to end the limb sequence becomes a metronome. The full stop the file carried for three rounds broke the beat once and cost nothing.
justification: Vote 1, read aloud as a native, two sentences either side of every changed span, then the two rationales end to end. fleet-repair-3 discharged the three pre-existing paraphrase-then-quote stutters this vote filed at r3 and discharged them well. ”vara regel och inte undantag” abstracts where the quotation specifies, which is the right shape, and it is a better string than the ”text på hela repertoaren” this vote prescribed — the round is correct that the repertoire includes lilla scenen, which the writer expressly leaves outside her demand, so my own string would have half-vouched for distractor D. ”det pris som ensemblen betalar” drops the kostnad lemma and says who bears it. ”en successiv utbyggnad” lands. The -vändning rhyme this vote filed as repair-introduced is gone, and the round was right to refuse my replacement, which would have put ”ett svepskäl” nine words in front of the quotation's own ”Ett svepskäl är det inte”. Three of five findings applied, one applied by a better route, one out of scope. What the round then wrote is three smaller things, all of them in the seams: a semantic pre-echo where a lexical one was removed, a repetition where an ambiguity was removed, and a metronome where a system was unified. Flag: three editor's fixes, none of them errors a student would call wrong.

findings: De andra kvällarna gissar jag mig fram genom andra akten -> De kvällar som saknar text gissar jag mig fram genom andra akten (passage §1; ORIGINAL GENERATOR COPY, carried through three rounds. Both r3 votes filed it, and both filed only half of it: ”andra” twice in seven words in two senses. The larger fault is reference. The two preceding sentences establish ”Raden rymmer fyra kvällar” and ”Jag har varit på tre av dem”, so the nearest available antecedent for ”De andra kvällarna” is the one remaining textad evening of the four — singular, and the wrong set. The sentence means the evenings without text, which are a different class entirely. The prescribed ”De övriga kvällarna” repairs the homonym and leaves the false antecedent standing.

Rätt svar D: texten säger vilka två kategorier raden ligger mellan: ”I länsteaterns höstprogram -> Rätt svar D: texten säger vilka två kategorier raden ligger mellan. ”I länsteaterns höstprogram (q2 rationale, key limb; written at fleet-repair-2 and untouched since. Two colons in one sentence. fleet-repair-3 did not repair it — it copied the shape into q1's key limb instead, on the ground that a colon before every quotation is one system. The unit now carries the fault twice where it carried it once.
justification: Vote 2, systematic grammar sweep on the final bytes. Both r3 items landed as written or better. The anaphoric ”den” after ”radens” is now ”symbolen”, which is the disambiguating repetition the repeated-noun rule carves out. The correspondence gap in the C limb is closed with the span this vote named, verified byte-identical, and ”vilket” is now ”som” with a nominal antecedent. Clean on: en/ett (en rad, ett svepskäl, en skärm, ett uppslag, en mottagare, en replik, ett spelår, ett annat motstånd); predicative agreement (inklämd on en rad, ”är den mörk” on skärmen, ”Ett svepskäl är det inte” with the correct neuter predicational det); pronoun gender on every anaphor, including the new B limb's ”den”, where the only common-gender candidate in reach is invändningen and motstånd is neuter; BIFF at every negation; subordinate word order; prepositions; compounds established, none coined; no non-words; no omitted som. Quote fidelity perfect: nine spans, nine exact, eighteen balanced marks. Nothing in the new rationale copy is ungrammatical and nothing in the unit contradicts anything else in it — the four evenings, the three attended, the guest performances and the coda's arithmetic all reconcile. Two findings: one reference fault in a passage nobody has edited since generation, and one punctuation fault that this round propagated instead of repairing. Flag.

findings: Vad sägs i texten om raden för textade föreställningar? -> (no change prescribed) (q2 stem; recorded for the coordinator, not for repair. The five-token opener ”Vad sägs i texten om” is byte-identical with las-b22-003 q1 in this same batch. It is a batch-composition item, both units disclose it from their own side, and G-REGISTER has ruled it a non-defect twice. Not this gate's to repair and not counted against the unit.)
justification: Vote 3, register and genre, and this vote holds at pass for a second round. The passage is byte-identical to the bytes it passed at r3 — fleet-repair-3 touched only the two rationales — and it is still real Swedish debattprosa in a named, situated first person: observation, mechanism, the opponents' case at full strength and conceded, the demand with its scope fixed, then the things she refuses to ask for. The accessibility register is Swedish and not translated: hörselslinga, T-läge, syntolkning, textade föreställningar, textremsa, gästspel, spelår, vaktmästeri. The coda still holds the voice. The new rationale copy is checked separately and holds it too: ”vara regel och inte undantag” is the ordinary Swedish pairing, ”det pris som ensemblen betalar” is unambiguous where a bare ”priset för ensemblen” would have read as what the ensemble costs to hire, ”gå i god för” is idiomatic and in register, and ”en successiv utbyggnad” is standard Swedish for what option C proposes rather than administrative drift — this vote considered it against the ”vinteråtgärd” standard it applies in las-b22-003 and clears it, because provision planning is the subject of the piece and the essä about farm winters had no such licence. Swept and found nothing on English lemmas inflected as Swedish, English metawords, snake_case, bracketed trap labels, rule self-attestation, anglicisms or bench vocabulary; the rationales say texten and skribenten throughout and never passagen or uppsättningen. The double-colon openers this gate's other two votes file are punctuation, not register, and are assigned to them. Pass.

findings: C följer texten ända fram till dragaren. Så långt stämmer det, men samma mening säger vem som drog: -> C följer texten ända fram till dragaren, men samma mening säger vem som drog: (q1 rationale, C limb; NEW at fleet-repair-3, adopted verbatim from G-SPRÅK r3 vote 1. The echo it removes was real — ”Bytet till kälke” twelve words before the quotation's ”på kälke” — but the old run-up also carried information, and the replacement carries none: ”Så långt stämmer det” restates the sentence immediately before it and adds nothing the ”men” does not already imply. Merging the two sentences keeps the concession the ”men” needs and drops the empty one. This vote wrote the string and withdraws it.

Förklaringen ligger i marken: -> Hindret låg i marken: (q1 rationale, D limb; NEW at fleet-repair-3. Measured on the final bytes, q1's rationale now carries four reason-nouns — ”Skälet” at token 10 in the key limb, ”skälet” at 136, ”Förklaringen” at 157 and ”skäl” at 175 — with three of them inside forty tokens of one limb. The round's log discloses the skälet/skäl pair as the limb's deliberate antithesis, which it is; the third term standing between them is what turns a pair into a cluster. ”Hindret” names the same thing, is what the quoted clause is actually about, and leaves the antithesis intact.

Alternativet förvandlar en utväg som texten avfärdar till något som räckte. -> Alternativet låter en avfärdad utväg räcka ändå. (q1 rationale, B limb; written at fleet-repair-1 and never touched since, read by nine G-SPRÅK votes across three rounds and filed by none. ”förvandlar … till” is split by an eight-token relative clause, so the reader holds the verb open across ”som texten avfärdar” before ”till” lands, and then has to reattach it. The replacement keeps the limb's closing ”Alternativet”, which vote 3 established at r3 as this question's one structural regularity.
justification: Vote 1, read aloud as a native with two sentences either side of every changed span, then both rationales end to end. All nine of this vote's r3 findings were addressed and seven were taken verbatim; the two that were not are recorded in my measurements and both departures are defensible. The key-limb repairs in q2 are the round's best work: ”Tiden varierade från år till år”, the connective ”och andra år” with a shortened but byte-identical second span, and ”Beslutet föll sent” all remove the echo and none of them costs the argument a step. ”lämnat i stallet” removes a tongue-twister and keeps the antecedent. The q1 D limb no longer re-quotes the key limb's own span and closes on ”Alternativet” like its three neighbours, which is what this vote and vote 3 both asked for. But two of the round's own replacements introduce smaller faults in the same limbs — one sentence that restates its predecessor and adds nothing, one reason-noun too many in a limb whose argument runs on exactly two — and the unchanged B limb still carries a stranded particle that no vote in three rounds has read. Flag: three editor's fixes, none of them an error a student would call wrong.

findings: Men texten ger den ingen syssla alls under de morgnarna. -> Men texten ger den ingen syssla alls när skaren bar. (q1 rationale, D limb; ”de morgnarna” was written at fleet-repair-2 and kept when fleet-repair-3 rewrote the sentence around it. Measured over the whole question — prompt, four options and rationale — it is the ONLY morgon-form in q1's student-facing copy, so the definite plural points at nothing the student has been given inside the item and must be recovered from the passage six paragraphs back. ”skaren” is a glossary head and occurs eight times in the passage, so the replacement anchors where the passage anchors.

Rätt svar A: Texten säger: ”Hästen fick stå i stallet”. -> Rätt svar A: ”Hästen fick stå i stallet”. (q1 rationale, key limb; the double colon was created at fleet-repair-1, which rewrote ”Texten säger att ”Hästen …”” into the colon form to kill an att-plus-capitalised-quote tic. It killed the tic and left two colons in eight words. The attribution ”Texten säger” is also redundant in a rationale that says ”texten” four more times; the bare form is what las-b22-001 uses in three of its four key limbs.

Och ytan krävde en viss följd av dygn med rätt väder för att alls bildas. -> Och det krävdes en viss följd av dygn med rätt väder för att ytan alls skulle bildas. (q2 rationale, key limb; ORIGINAL GENERATOR COPY, untouched by all three rounds and filed by no gate. As written the surface is the subject of a requirement for its own formation: it demands the conditions under which it comes into being. The replacement puts the requirement where it belongs, keeps the limb's third piece of evidence, and keeps ”ytan”, which the D limb picks up sixty tokens later.

Tillsammans ger det ett arbete vars dagar ingen kunde bestämma på förhand. -> Tillsammans beskriver de ett arbete vars dagar ingen kunde bestämma på förhand. (q2 rationale, key limb; adjusted at fleet-repair-1, filed by G-SPRÅK r3 vote 2, carried unrepaired by fleet-repair-3 as outside the commissioned list. The antecedent is the explicit plural ”tre uppgifter” two sentences earlier and the singular summative ”det” after it is loose; ”ge ett arbete” is also the wrong verb for what three pieces of evidence do to a description. Reproduced here so that the finding does not read as discharged.
justification: Vote 2, systematic grammar sweep on the final bytes. Both r3 items in copy this vote owned landed: option C is ”Hästarna drog kälken i stället”, so the option and the quotation that kills it now agree in number and the unanchored definite plural is gone; the knotted ”och någon annan lämnar texten inte” is gone with the limb that carried it. The splice in the q2 key limb is grammatically sound — ”och andra år” is a fronted adverbial and the quoted ”blev det” keeps its V2 inversion, so the connective works without touching a byte of either span. Clean on: en/ett (ett tryck, en lyftning, ett lyssnande, en skiva, en isskorpa, ett tunt hårt lock, ett lass, en hov, en tallrik); definiteness in the passage (den obrukade åkern, morgonens väg, the kälke-to-kälken introduction chain); predicative and attributive agreement; BIFF at every negation; the participle relative ”det som kälkmedarna packat” keeps its som and drops har correctly; prepositions; both glossary heads occur in the body; twelve of twelve quoted spans byte-identical by extraction and membership. Nothing in the unit contradicts anything else in it: the four-to-ten window, the sky read the evening before, the heel test at the door and the ten-o'clock deadline all reconcile. Four findings — one definite with no antecedent inside its own question, one double colon a repair created three rounds ago, one loose subject in copy nobody has ever edited, and one carried item still live. Flag.

findings: I arbetets morgnar saknas de. -> Under arbetets morgnar saknas de. (q2 rationale, C limb; NEW at fleet-repair-3. The round's own draft log records two discarded drafts opening ”Under arbetets morgnar …” and ”Arbetets morgnar beskrivs …”, and the sentence that was written changed the preposition without comment. Swedish takes ”under” with a genitive plural time span; ”i … morgnar” is the shape an English ”in the working mornings” takes when it is carried straight across, and it is the one preposition in either rationale that a native stops on.

Alternativet gör en lek till en arbetsordning. -> Alternativet gör en lek till en arbetsfördelning. (q2 rationale, C limb; written at fleet-repair-2 and kept verbatim when fleet-repair-3 rewrote the limb around it. Two faults. ”arbetsordning” is rules-of-procedure Swedish, the same administrative-compound class G-SPRÅK r3 vote 2 filed four limbs away as ”vinteråtgärd … administrative Swedish sitting inside an essä about farm winters” — a standard that was applied to the q1 B limb and not to this one. It is also the wrong word for what the rebuilt option says: children loading while the adults drive is a division of labour, which is arbetsfördelning.
justification: Vote 3, register and genre. The passage is byte-identical to the bytes this vote read at r3 — verified by the round's own $.passage sha256, which is unchanged — and it remains the best-written of the three: the V1 conditionals in §1, ”Veckorna kom när de kom”, ”Var gård körde för sig”, the two upphöjda ryggar closing across the mire. The coda still turns the subject into something looked at rather than used, which is what makes this an essä rather than a description. The item this vote failed the unit on at r3 is discharged and discharged properly: the q1 D limb no longer re-quotes the key limb's span, the stå-count in q1's copy is back to three with two of them locked inside quotations, and the limb closes on ”Alternativet” like its three neighbours, so the question's one structural regularity is whole for the first time since r1. ”lämna” now occurs once in q1's copy and in its ordinary modern sense, not the officialese sense this vote faulted. The two rebuilt q2 options sit inside the voice rather than against it — ”Barnen fick lasta medan de vuxna var ute och körde” and ”Man fortsatte tills sista lasset var hemma” are both plain farm Swedish and neither reaches for the essay's own lyric. Swept and found nothing on blog drift, rhetorical-question padding, anglicisms, English lemmas inflected as Swedish, snake_case, bracketed trap labels, rule self-attestation, or the document-reading present standing in for a past. What keeps this from a pass is two items in the rationale layer, one written this round and one carried through it: a preposition that reads as carried across from English, and an administrative compound that the same standard this gate applied one question earlier catches. Flag.
